name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the given context of the conversation.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses how engaging or interesting the response is, encouraging further conversation.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and understandability of the response within the context.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 is not coherent at all and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Informativeness
description: Measures how much useful or interesting information is provided in the response.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 is not informative at all and 5 is highly informative.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and creativity of the response in contributing to the conversation.
scale: Scale from 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative at all and 5 is highly creative.
